content:
**Smoked Scorchbeast Lung** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A cooked Scorchbeast Lung, smoked at a cooking station.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Scorchbeast Lung (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Scorchbeast Lung | | Smoked Scorchbeast Lung (1) | 

Can be crafted at any Cooking Station, after having picked up a Scorchbeast Lung for the first time.
